question: _______ literally means 'dance of the enchantress'. It is one of the most striking in the Indian classical dance repertoire.
solution:
The correct answer is **Mohiniyattam**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohiniyattam** is derived from the words "Mohini" meaning enchantress and "Attam" meaning dance.
 
• This dance form originates from the Indian state of **Kerala**.
 
• It is characterized by graceful, swaying body movements and subtle facial expressions.
 
• Mohiniyattam is often performed as a solo recital by women.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Kuchipudi: A classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, known for its quick footwork and dramatic characterization.
 
 

 Option 2
 Mohiniyattam: A classical dance form from Kerala, often called the "dance of the enchantress".
 
 

 Option 3
 Kathakali: A classical dance-drama from Kerala, known for its elaborate costumes and face masks.
 
 

 Option 4
 Bharatanatyam: A classical dance form from Tamil Nadu, known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork.
